program:
PARAMS = {
    "gm1":   (2.6e-3, 2.0e-3, 3.4e-3),
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmidp": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),
    "Av":    (17.0, 13.0, 22.0),
    "voutt": (0.9, 0.7, 1.1),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    vo = p["voutt"]

    # Solve M1 gm/Id so that VGS == VIN_DC (vgs falls as gm/Id rises)
    lo, hi = 4.0, 24.0
    for _ in range(40):
        g = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        t = lut.size("n", g, p["L1"], 100e-6, vds=vo)
        if t.vgs > vin:
            lo = g
        else:
            hi = g
    gmid1 = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    I1 = p["gm1"] / gmid1
    m1 = lut.size("n", gmid1, p["L1"], I1, vds=vo)

    # Output conductance budget -> shunt resistor to VDD
    Gt = m1.gm / p["Av"]
    Rl = 1.0 / Gt          # initial guess
    for _ in range(5):
        Ir = (vdd - vo) / Rl
        Ip = max(I1 - Ir, 5e-6)
        m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ip, vds=vdd - vo)
        Gr = Gt - m1.gds - m2.gds
        Gr = max(Gr, 1e-6)
        Rl = 1.0 / Gr
    Ir = (vdd - vo) / Rl
    Ip = max(I1 - Ir, 5e-6)
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ip, vds=vdd - vo)

    # Bias chain: ibias -> NMOS diode -> NMOS mirror -> PMOS diode -> M2
    mn3 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.7)
    mn4 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.9)
    mp3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], iref, vds=m2.vgs)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m2)
    n.R("RL", "vout", "vdd", Rl)
    n.dev("MN3", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn3)
    n.dev("MN4", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn4)
    n.dev("MP3", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp3)

    G = m1.gds + m2.gds + 1.0 / Rl
    A = m1.gm / G
    Ctot = cl + m1.cdd + m2.cdd + m1.cgd
    f3 = G / (2 * PI * Ctot)
    power = vdd * (I1 + 2 * iref)
    swing = (vdd - m2.vdsat - 0.05) - (m1.vdsat + 0.05)
    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A),
        "f3db": f3,
        "gbw": A * f3,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vo,
        "swing": swing,
    }
